propositions: Packaged prose guides cite criterion ids without mechanical coupling to the registry, allowing silent semantic drift when a criterion's authoritative text is rewritten.
The plan guide cites 20 distinct criteria ids (G6, F1, E2, COH, ISF, etc.) with no systematic validation that each citation still accurately paraphrases the current criterion rubric.
A new citation-pin manifest gate must detect when a cited criterion's text changes, failing the build and naming the stale pin so the guide author re-verifies the claim and re-pins.
The pin manifest is derived and regenerated on demand, not hand-authored, so guide prose rewording and restructuring without citation changes must not trigger a gate failure.
Citation extraction must match the closed criterion-id vocabulary at word boundaries without depending on guide markup or structure, to avoid coupling the gate to prose layout conventions.
